entry.name: apiKey
entry.label: OpenRouter API key (inference key, sk-or-v1-...)

entry.name: apiKeyFile
entry.label: Path to a file containing the API key. Takes precedence over apiKey.

entry.name: managementKey
entry.label: Optional management/provisioning key for /credits and /activity

entry.name: managementKeyFile
entry.label: Path to a file containing the management key. Takes precedence.

entry.name: refreshInterval
entry.label: Refresh interval in seconds

entry.name: refreshOnOpen
entry.label: Refresh when the popup is opened

entry.name: lowThreshold
entry.label: Balance below which the widget warns

entry.name: criticalThreshold
entry.label: Balance below which the widget shows a critical state

entry.name: usageBaseline
entry.label: total_usage as it was at the first poll of the current UTC day

entry.name: usageBaselineDate
entry.label: UTC day the baseline above belongs to

entry.name: notifyLow
entry.label: Send a notification when the balance drops below the warning threshold

entry.name: language
entry.label: Interface language; empty means follow the Plasma locale

entry.name: compactItems
entry.label: Comma separated metrics shown in the panel: balance, limit, today, week, month, total, credits, requests

entry.name: compactLabels
entry.label: Prefix every panel value with a short caption

entry.name: compactStacked
entry.label: Stack the panel values vertically instead of side by side

entry.name: compactSeparator
entry.label: Separator drawn between panel values

entry.name: compactPrefix
entry.label: Text shown in front of the value in the panel

entry.name: colorize
entry.label: Colour the panel value according to the thresholds

entry.name: favoriteModels
entry.label: Comma separated list of favourite model ids

entry.name: pricingUnit
entry.label: Token unit used to display model prices (1000 or 1000000)

entry.name: calcInputTokens
entry.label: Default input tokens for the cost calculator

entry.name: calcOutputTokens
entry.label: Default output tokens for the cost calculator
